user.title: Kismet Tracker
user.description: Connect to the Kismet REST API (port 2501 by default). Either track every device Kismet reports in a recent time window, or only MAC addresses you list.

data.track_all_visible_devices: Track all devices seen by Kismet in the last 24 hours (large number of entities)
data.whitelist: MAC allow list when the option above is off (comma or newline separated)
data.ignore_randomized_local_mac: Ignore locally administered (randomized) MACs in the allow list
data.away_timeout: Away timeout (seconds) since last Kismet observation
data.min_rssi_for_home: Minimum RSSI for home (-200 disables RSSI gate)
data.enable_air_sensors: Enable recent RF device count sensor
